text:
Ibrahim K: Heads up — Meridian Labs renewal is asking to shorten to a 3-month bridge with the same monthly rate. Procurement insists on original PO; CFO is remote until next week. They asked whether e-signatures are acceptable due to travel.
billing-bot: Created renewal amendment ML-3MO-BRIDGE v0.1 https://contracts.internal/ML-3MO-BRIDGE (locked)
Claire S: Sales note: rep verbally okayed maintaining monthly rate for the bridge if we include a write-up that they will true-up at the next renewal. Need written approval from sales manager.
Tom H: Procurement will send a scanned PO tonight, courier originals earliest next Monday. They also asked for company vendor code and our W-9.
Legal-Review: Legal can accept e-signatures if we get a delegation confirmation email from an authorized signer. Otherwise originals required. Also we need to avoid making price precedent.
Rosie P: CSM says customer is mid-pilot and wants access to test capacity ASAP; they're asking for limited provisioning before originals arrive. Is that allowed?
Ibrahim K: We can enable limited test access with a billing hold if we have scanned PO + PO number + W-9. Hardware enablement requires originals. Let's capture action items.
Claire S: Action items:
- Claire: get sales manager approval for pricing concession in writing (by EOD)
- Tom: collect scanned PO + W-9 and courier ETA (scanned by tonight?)
- Legal-Review: prepare delegation language for e-sign allowance
- Rosie: confirm pilot scope and any temporary seat increases
Billing-bot: AR ticket pre-created pending PO number.
Ibrahim K: If any delays, offer a 7day courtesy extension. Also note: if they later convert to Dedicated, we'll require executed amendment and original PO before billing for hardware.
Claire S: I'll follow up with the rep and loop in sales manager.
Tom H: Scanned PO expected tonight, will update thread.
Legal-Review: Drafted delegation clause and inserted into ML-3MO-BRIDGE. Leaving notes for AR about e-sign acceptance criteria.
